t: What Eclipse Chasing Is All About
title: What Eclipse Chasing Is All About
description: Eclipse chasers travel the world to stand in the Moon's shadow during total solar eclipses — minutes of midday darkness, corona, and awe. It's part astronomy, part pilgrimage, part travel addiction. Wherever the path of totality falls — recent US eclipses, upcoming Europe and North Africa. Chasers plan years ahead. This record lays the foundation: the core purpose, the people it serves, and where it fits in everyday life.
